title: DOM drawn across a fold
blurb: Two panes placed by devicePosture and viewport.segments, and one element drawn across the hinge. A fold control stands in for the device: buttons and text fields work on a half drawn at 100°.
question: What can a canvas that draws live DOM do with the posture and the viewport segments of a foldable: place panes on each half, draw one element across the hinge, and keep input working on a tilted half?
result: All three work with a simulated fold. A real foldable has not been tried.
